name: ai.festivai/festiv
title: Festiv
description: Find restaurants, cafés, bars, events and what's on in Malaysia, in English, Malay or Chinese.

tools.name: search_venues
tools.description: Find restaurants, cafes, bars, entertainment, leisure and wellness venues in Malaysia by words and filters. Use it when the user wants options in a place (neighbourhood, city or near a landmark), a cuisine, a certified-halal requirement, menu-checked dietary needs (no pork / no alcohol on the menu), a price band, or places open right now. Use the filters, not free text, for needs: set no_pork_menu / no_alcohol_menu rather than typing 'no pork' (free text matches menus that mention pork); set venue_type=dining for a meal (lunch, dinner, a date) so cafés, dessert bars and bars are not returned, and venue_type=cafe or bar when those are wanted. City names accept the usual short forms (KL, PJ, JB, Penang). Returns up to 20 compact cards with a rating (from Google reviews), price level 1–4 (with price_level_source: type_estimate when it is estimated from the venue type, not a known price), a price_range (a per-person spend when source is google = reported by reviewers, owner or admin = entered by the venue or Festiv staff, menu_estimate = estimated from the menu; source menu = the spread of menu item prices, a weaker signal), cuisines, the venue's address and coordinates (for a map), `halal_certified` only when a halal certificate is on record, a `dietary` block with menu observations and their provenance note, `nearby: true` for venues just outside the named neighbourhood, open-now status and a link to the Festiv page. Only `halal_certified: true` means a venue is halal; a `dietary` note is a menu observation, not a halal status of any kind.

query.description: Free words: a venue name, dish, cuisine or vibe, e.g. 'omakase', 'rooftop cocktails'.
query.title: Query

area.description: Neighbourhood or district name, e.g. 'Bangsar', 'KLCC', 'George Town'. A name Festiv does not know is refused, not guessed; a city or region word such as 'Penang' or 'Klang Valley' is read as a city.
area.title: Area

city.description: City when no neighbourhood is known, e.g. 'Kuala Lumpur', 'Petaling Jaya', 'Penang'.
city.title: City

near.description: A mall, hotel or attraction name to search within 1.5 km of, e.g. 'Pavilion KL', 'Suria KLCC', 'Mid Valley Megamall'. Unknown names are refused (use area or city instead). Coordinates are not accepted.
near.title: Near

venue_type.description: One of dining, cafe, bar, entertainment, leisure, wellness, mall.
venue_type.title: Venue Type

halal.description: True = only venues with a verified halal certificate on record (few venues; for dietary needs prefer no_pork_menu / no_alcohol_menu).
halal.title: Halal

open_now.description: True = open at this moment in Malaysia time.
open_now.title: Open Now

no_pork_menu.description: True = only venues whose published menu was checked and lists no pork (a menu observation, not a halal status).
no_pork_menu.title: No Pork Menu

no_alcohol_menu.description: True = only venues whose published menu was checked and lists no alcohol (a menu observation, not a halal status).
no_alcohol_menu.title: No Alcohol Menu

max_price_per_person.description: Budget in ringgit per person, e.g. 20 for 'under RM20'; only venues with a known per-person price at or below it qualify.
max_price_per_person.title: Max Price Per Person

language.description: Reply language for summaries: en, ms (Malay) or zh (Chinese). Venue names stay in their original script.
language.title: Language

tools.name: get_venue
tools.description: Everything Festiv knows about one venue: type, neighbourhood (or `nearest_area` when it sits just outside one), address and coordinates, phone, website, weekly opening hours and whether it is open now (`hours_by_programme: true` = no fixed hours: they depend on what's on, and the venue is not closed), price level (price_level_source: type_estimate = estimated from the venue type, not a known price), cuisines, `halal` (present only when a verified halal certificate is on record: authority and valid-to date), `dietary` (menu observations such as 'No pork on this menu' with a provenance note — not a halal status), `alcohol_served` only when known, amenities, a short description, awards (MICHELIN and others) and press quotes with their sources, reservation and delivery links, the next few events at the venue, and the Festiv page link. Pass the venue name (add the area if the name is common) or a Festiv slug from an earlier result; if the name is not in Festiv the error lists the closest names instead of guessing.

tools.name: find_things_to_do
tools.description: What's on in Malaysia: events, shows, workshops, tastings and other experiences for a time window: today, tonight, tomorrow, this weekend, this week, or a date (YYYY-MM-DD). Filter by neighbourhood or city, a category word (e.g. 'live music', 'workshop', 'kids') and free-only. Dated events come first with start and end times; items marked `anytime: true` are ongoing venue experiences bookable on any day, not scheduled events. `dated_count` is the number of dated events in the window; 0 means Festiv has none, and the items returned are ongoing experiences. Each item has the venue, price and a link.

tools.name: recommend_picks
tools.description: Ranked picks for an occasion, using Festiv's scoring (no guesswork): date_night, anniversary, birthday, first_date, family_kids, team_outing, after_work, girls_night_out, friends_hangout, tourist_day, foodie_tour, wellness, ramadan_iftar, cny_celebration, quick_bite, late_night, solo_explorer, vibe_explorer, surprise. Give a neighbourhood, city or landmark; optional budget (low, mid, high), party size, time (tonight, this_weekend, a date), cuisine and halal. Each pick says why it fits.

tools.name: get_best_of
tools.description: Festiv's curated, data-ranked guides for Kuala Lumpur (fine dining, cafes, cocktail bars, Japanese, Korean, Italian, Thai, halal-certified restaurants, family-friendly places, spas, gyms, museums …). Without a topic it lists the guides; with a topic (slug or words like 'japanese restaurants') it returns the ranked entries with ratings, price level, cuisines and links. Rankings come from Google review data; nothing in them is sponsored.

tools.name: get_awards
tools.description: Venues in Malaysia with a recognised award on record: MICHELIN stars, Bib Gourmand, MICHELIN Selected, Asia's 50 Best and others, with the award year, cuisine, price level and a link. Filter by source (michelin, bib_gourmand, michelin_selected, fifty_best, other), year, neighbourhood and city. The list is national: without `city`, a question about Kuala Lumpur also returns George Town venues.
